top_choice_rationale: P001 credits Katori and Ye for a separable invention, magic-wavelength trapping of many neutral atoms, which removes the lattice light shift and lets quantum projection noise fall with atom number, and for its realization at the 10^-18 level. It is independently reproduced in Sr and Yb laboratories and already used for physics (gravitational redshift across sub-millimetre heights, constraints on constant variation). The two-name allocation is uncontested and the citation scope is clear; the category worry about a third precision-metrology prize is real but does not outweigh the maturity of the work, so I prefer it to no award.
